title: Negative result: Corollary J fails on the whole #2111 121-line pool for every phi (rank 266, 30/30 immovable); exhaustive <=5-line immovable atoms all satisfy cost >= v
body:
**Status: Research note / scoped negative result (no κ claim).** Track 40-49 Structural decoder research, sprint seed 43. Scope: #1166 OPEN ENDS item 5b. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18941077

## What was learned
New package `research/pool121-jet-rigidity/`. It applies the #2162 B-independent first-order jet certificate (Corollary J) to the whole #2111 121-line T=3 unit-world pool for the first time.

1. **Pool-level failure (complete finite certificate).** In the unit world φ(±1)=1 is forced, so (J1) has the same F2 coefficients for every admissible φ and every characteristic-2 field. (J1) has 2646 rows, 510 unknowns and F2 rank **266**; two code-disjoint eliminations agree. The 245 explicit gauge + torus motions span dimension **244 = 510 − 266**, so the first-order solution space is exactly gauge + torus. All **30 of 30** harmonic lines are immovable, with 30 explicit Lemma F flows as dual witnesses (10–14 edges each, all even). Corollary J therefore cannot certify the pool for any φ.
   - Scope note (from review): the pool's incidence digraph has one 70-line strong component holding all 30 harmonic lines, plus 51 singletons stripped by #2111 Lemma SCC/Peel. The real test object is the 70-line core.
2. **Higher orders.** Proposition R (proved in the README by hand, not machine-checked; only its finite premise is checked): on a configuration whose solution space is gauge + torus, the uniform order-m version of Corollary J fails at every order. That applies to the pool and to 17 of the 42 stored atoms. The #2162 order-2 test fails on all 42 atoms.
3. **Minimal immovable sub-configurations (exhaustive up to 5 lines).** No such sub-configuration has 3 or fewer lines. The immovable 4-line ones form one orbit, with cost 5 = v+1. There are 353 orbits of minimal 5-line ones, and none is CR2 over GF(2^k) for k ≤ 4. Their exact min cost − v is {0:4, 1:103, 2:184, 3:55, 4:7}, with C and Python enumerators agreeing. **So (A) holds on all of them.**
   - **Correction after review:** the 4 tight orbits (cost = v) are *not* uncertified test cases. Each has a unit line and a non-strongly-connected digraph, so #2111 Lemma SCC/Peel plus Corollary J on components already gives cost ≥ v.
   - An independent reviewer script reports that this reduction covers 242/353 five-line orbits and 39/42 stored atoms. It also reports that the 111 strongly connected minimal 5-line orbits all have slack ≥ 1. That reduction count is reviewer evidence and is not replayed by `verify.py`.
4. **Greedy atom search:** 42 inclusion-minimal orbits (v = 4..10), each with exact cost v+1..v+5. The B-dependent jet passes on all 1305 minimisers; this is a consistency check, not a certificate.
5. **Q4 (failed search):** the largest jet-certifiable sub-pool found has 103 lines, giving cost ≥ 103 < Theorem U 106 ≤ MCC 119. This is not a bound on the method.

**Jet failure is not evidence against (A). No counterexample to (A) was found and no κ is claimed.**

## Reproduce
- Base commit: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (main is unchanged as of submission).
- Pins (SOURCES.json, NOTICE.md): vendored `cr2.py`, `enumall.c` and `tied_min.json` from #2162 head `113a7182` (sha256 pinned); pool definition from #2111 head `98da76c2`, re-implemented; tooling pattern from #2274 `67294e7d`.

```
python3 -I -B research/pool121-jet-rigidity/verify.py
```
This uses only the stdlib plus `cc`, takes ~60 s, and should exit 0 with 30 PASS lines. The final line should be `PASS pool121 jet rigidity: (J1) rank 266 / solution dim 244 (= gauge + torus) / 30 of 30 harmonic lines immovable with Lemma F flows; 42 minimal immovable atom orbits (v 4..10), all non-CR2 (GF(2..16)) with exact min cost >= v + 1, order-2 jets fail on all; minimum immovable size 4 (one orbit); 353 minimal 5-line orbits, all cost >= v, 4 tight (cost = v); Q4 search best certifiable S = 103 < 106 <= 119`.

`--full` re-runs the exhaustive 5-line enumeration and the CR2 DFS: 32 PASS lines, 534 s measured. The default mode trusts the stored 5-line completeness and non-CR2 labels. All replays used Python 3.14.

## Controls
- **Positive control:** tied_min is jet-movable (G8).
- **Negative controls:**
  - N1: a flow with one edge dropped is rejected.
  - N2: a non-incidence edge is rejected; a corrupted pool line changes the rank from 266 to 265.
  - N3: non-homomorphic ψ(−1)=ω breaks all 2646 order-0 incidences (an order-0 sanity control).
  - N4: every one-line deletion of every atom and orbit is jet-movable.
  - N5: the order-2 test without the X1·Y1 term is rejected.
- **Reviewer mutations** M1–M5 of the stored data each trigger exactly the targeted FAIL.

## Scope, inherited assumptions, unresolved obligations
- **Inherited and not audited here:** #2162 Corollary J / VCR2 / Lemma F / CR2 / Theorem B2; #2111 Lemma SCC/Peel and the cost model. #2293 lists Corollary J as unchecked.
- **Proposition R and the order-2 reading of G11** are hand proofs; there is no formal proof.
- **Search coverage:** non-CR2 status covers GF(2^k), k ≤ 4 only. Atoms with more than 5 lines come from greedy search only (seed 43; flow-support starts with 40 orders per harmonic line, plus 8 whole-pool orders), so missed atoms are not excluded. Q4 used greedy insertion over 16 orders plus one scratch-only swap pass that was not replayed.
- **Not run:** the SCC/Peel classification is not yet in `verify.py` (open question 1).
- **Not covered:** orders ≥ 3 on the 25 non-rigid atoms, non-uniform VCR2, and other char-2 base points.
- **Generated data hashes** in SOURCES.json are informational. Correctness is checked semantically.

- **Concurrent related work** (no overlap with the pool jet test): #2330 (theon199, #2162 §3 split min-max audit), #2340 (navinor, B2(iii) MAS edge form false), #2334 (ROTl24, B2 acyclic-edge strengthening counterexample).
- **What this adds:** #2162 ran Corollary J only on tied_min, random configurations and jf0..2, so this is the first whole-pool application, giving an exact φ-independent rigidity certificate and an exhaustive ≤5-line atom classification.
